description: Genuinely new competitors are rare. A window whose cards are all about competitors already in the register must produce an empty candidate list — the single most important behaviour here, because padding adds an organisation that eleven scanners then watch and name.

cards.headline: DVT announces a Fabric migration practice for mid-market groups
cards.so_what: A known competitor moving onto the platform Canvas is productised on

cards.headline: PBT Group reports growth in its data engineering division
cards.so_what: A known competitor's own results commentary

expected_output.shape: single JSON object with keys horizon_days, candidates

rubric.condition: The candidates array contains exactly 0 items — every card names a competitor already in known_competitors, so there is nothing to propose.
The entire output parses as a single JSON object with json.loads and no surrounding prose or markdown fences.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md's opening paragraph and hard rules 2 and 3. This is the inverse of function 17's minimum-of-3 floor, and deliberately so: a floor here would manufacture competitors.
